definition: Simpler fractions, each over one linear factor, that add up to a given fraction, such as $\frac{5}{x - 5} - \frac{1}{x + 1}$ for $\frac{4x + 10}{(x - 5)(x + 1)}$.
An algebraic fraction whose numerator has a lower degree than its denominator, such as $\frac{3x + 2}{x^{2} - 1}$.
Matching the coefficient of each power of $x$ on the two sides of an identity, to get equations for unknown constants.
